name: io.github.SorataYang/qiao-mcp
title: Qiao-MCP — Bridge Engineering (桥梁工程)
description: Full-lifecycle bridge structural analysis — modeling, staging, code checks.

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Backend adapter to use. Currently only 'qtmodel' (QiaoTong) is implemented; more backends are planned.

environmentVariables.name: QIAOTONG_HTTP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the QiaoTong HTTP endpoint. Only needed when the software runs on another machine or a non-default port — must use the host 'localhost' rather than 127.0.0.1.
